tool_args.rationale: The five observations vary substrate and gradient together, so several smooth mechanisms can explain them. The open-branch probe is the lowest-cost relevant discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary substrate-and-gradient model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The coupled effects of substrate and sink gradient are confounded in the pilot, leaving the functional form and branch behavior unidentified.
The immediate ambiguity is branch structure, which the cheaper open-branch probe is designed to discriminate.
It does not address the mechanism ambiguity.
